modules.title: Computer vision

modules.title: The robotic arm

modules.title: Manipulation

modules.title: Machine learning for robots
modules.summary: Where ML actually earns its place on a robot — data, fine-tuning, edge deployment, learned models of dynamics, and evaluating ML inside a physical system.

modules.title: Reinforcement learning
modules.summary: RL in simulation first — states, actions, rewards, Q-learning, policy gradients, actor-critic, reward design and sim-to-real.

modules.title: Modern embodied AI
modules.summary: Imitation learning, ACT, diffusion policies, VLAs and robot foundation models — what is mature, what is research, and what you can run at home.
